verdict.rationale: Wise's own spend-controls API lets users create rules, based on merchant category code or transaction currency, that are applied automatically to card transaction events to permit or block them. That is a narrow, card-only rule capability. Webhook subscriptions are only a developer building block for event notification and are not credited here. missing for 10: a general rules/automation engine for events beyond card authorization (e.g., incoming payments or balance changes triggering transfers or conversions), configurable actions other than allow/deny, documentation of rule depth and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Control which card transactions are permitted by creating rules based on merchant category code (MCC) or transaction currency.
